_comment: Demo-local LIF-authored rules for the real Ed-Fi Student name fields (FirstName / MiddleName / LastSurname -> LIF Person.Name). Same shape as an exported MDR transformation group so scripts/generate-crosswalk-draft.py accepts it via --authored; pass it BEFORE the reference Ed-Fi file so these rows win the firstName / lastName targets (the reference rules split the seed model's single Student.Name string). Numeric EntityIdPath prefixes are ignored; resolution is by UniqueName.
Name: Northgate Ed-Fi v5 name rules

Transformations.Name: Person.Name.firstName
Transformations.Notes: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi Student.FirstName element.

Transformations.Name: Person.Name.lastName
Transformations.Notes: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi Student.LastSurname element.

Transformations.Name: Person.Name.initials
Transformations.Notes: 3:1 rule. Ed-Fi has no initials element; built from the first letter of FirstName, MiddleName (optional) and LastSurname. Lossy: a hyphenated or multi-word surname contributes one letter.
